Trump references Iraq war, football at Hispanic Heritage event

During a Hispanic Heritage Month event, former U.S. President Donald Trump referenced the Iraq war and mentioned football player Jaxson Dart. He also made a comment about the "Gulf of America," which was reported by multiple outlets. The Independent noted Trump's remarks about his ballroom and the Iraq war, while Metro.co.uk highlighted his "Gulf of America" comment.
